model_annotation: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for six model variants shown in the legend. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 20,000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. A purple solid line labeled “Vanilla” starts near about 3.4 at the left edge and decreases steeply early on, then more gradually, reaching roughly 2.46–2.48 by 140,000 iterations; it is accompanied by a faint purple band around the line. A light-blue solid line labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)” begins near about 3.4, drops quickly, then declines slowly from around 2.8 near 20,000 iterations to about 2.61–2.62 at 140,000, with a light-blue shaded band. An orange solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64)” decreases from near 3.4 at the start to around 2.7 by roughly 20,000 iterations and continues down to about 2.52–2.53 at 140,000, with an orange shaded band. A green solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)” follows a similar downward trajectory, going from near 3.4 initially to roughly 2.68–2.70 around 20,000 and ending near about 2.51–2.52 at 140,000, with a green shaded band. A red solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” also declines throughout, from near 3.4 at the start to about 2.66–2.68 around 20,000 and to roughly 2.49–2.50 by 140,000, with a red shaded band. A darker blue solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=128)” decreases from near 3.4 initially to around 2.65–2.67 near 20,000 and ends around 2.50–2.51 at 140,000, with a corresponding blue shaded band; all lines show a steep initial drop followed by a long, gradual decline across the remaining iterations.
